fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/ListingPages/BestTrucks.cy.js#ListingPages - NewListingPages [bestTrucks] [en] — Best Trucks TC-NLP-09: SecondaryNavbar jump links on Best Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NLP-09
**Title:** SecondaryNavbar jump links on Best Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Confirm the sticky SecondaryNavbar on Best Trucks shows every expected in-page jump link, then use FAQs to jump to Frequently Asked Questions.

**Expected Result:**
SecondaryNavbar items are visible and FAQs jumps to the FAQ heading.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Best Trucks listing page
2. Verify SecondaryNavbar items
3. Click FAQs
4. Verify the FAQ heading is shown
